name: soar-travel
description: Find travel destinations, check live flight status, compare flights and hotels, and view trips from your connected Soar account.

interface.longDescription: Soar helps travelers find destinations, check live flight status, compare flight fares and hotels, and view trips from a connected Soar account. Explore a curated catalog of 405 destinations with seasonal filters and guide links. Check gates, delays, and when to leave for the airport. Compare up to eight flight offers or hotel options, with links to book the top hotel picks on Soar. Connect your Soar account to see your flights, hotels, and reservations. Destination, flight, and hotel searches work without an account. Tools do not book, change, or cancel reservations; hotel checkout happens on Soar and prices are re-quoted there.
defaultPrompt: Where can I go for a warm beach trip in January?
Find hotels in Paris for November 20–23, 2026, under $250 per night.

positive.description: Destination ideas by season and budget
positive.prompt: Where should I go for a beach trip in January on a mid-range budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Use month 1, beach style, and Mid-range budget. Return matching destinations with reasons and Soar guide links; do not invent matches.

positive.prompt: What is the status of United flight 234 today?
positive.expected_behavior: Look up UA234 for today. Return current route, status, times and available gate or terminal. If no operating flight is found, clearly report that; do not invent a live status.

positive.prompt: Find economy flights from JFK to LHR on November 20, 2026, for one adult.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to eight available offers ranked by price with airline, times, stops and currency. Explain no availability or supplier failure honestly; never claim a booking was made.

positive.prompt: Find hotels in Paris for November 20–23, 2026, for two adults in one room, under $250 per night.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching hotels with nightly and total USD prices. Include the returned Soar checkout link for bookable picks and explain prices are re-quoted at checkout. No reservation is created by the tool.

When disconnected, prompt account connection. After sign-in with the dedicated reviewer account, retry and return only that account’s sample trips with the stored flights, hotels and reservations. If no trips exist, report that. Reviewer account setup is required before running this case.

negative.prompt: Cancel my hotel reservation and refund my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that these tools cannot cancel reservations or issue refunds. Do not claim an action occurred.

negative.prompt: Show me the private trips of another Soar user using their phone number.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request or use another person’s phone number to retrieve private trips. Explain that trip access is restricted to the connected account.

negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Paris.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for check-in and check-out dates before searching. Do not invent travel dates or silently create a shortlist.

review.commerce_description: Hotel searches provide links to Soar’s external web checkout for travel lodging. The MCP does not take payment or create, change, or cancel bookings. Prices are re-quoted at checkout.

publication.release_notes: Destination ideas, live flight status, flight and hotel search, and connected-account trips. Uses mixed anonymous and OAuth access with dynamic client registration.
